Short Information : According to the latest official updates, Bihar Public Service Commission (BPSC) will release the notification for the TRE 4.0 recruitment of School Teacher posts on the official website of BPSC. As per the notification, the online application process for Bihar School Teacher TRE 4.0 Recruitment 2026 will start soon. Tentatively, there are a total of 44,000+ vacancies that have been issued in the Bihar School Teacher TRE 4.0 Recruitment 2026 for Middle School Teachers, Secondary Teachers, and Higher Secondary Teacher posts. Candidates must check the tentative details for Bihar School Teacher TRE 4.0 Recruitment 2026 given below.

BPSC School Teacher TRE 4.0 Online Form 2026 : Educational Qualification 

Post Name Eligibility 
Primary School Teacher (Class 1-5)
  • Graduation Degree in Any Stream with Diploma in Elementary Education OR
  • Graduation Degree with 50% Marks and B.Ed Degree OR
  • 12th with 50% Marks with 2 Year Diploma in Elementary Education / Special Diploma OR
  • 12th with 45% Marks (As per 2002 Norms) with 2 Year Diploma in Elementary Education OR
  • 12th with 50% Marks with 4 Year BLEd Degree OR
  • Master Degree with 55% Marks and B.Ed – M.Ed 3 Year Degree.
  • CTET Paper I OR BTET Paper I Exam Qualified.
Middle School Teacher (Class 6-8)
  • Graduation Degree with 50% Marks & B.Ed Degree OR
  • Graduation / Post Graduation Degree with 50% Marks with B.Ed  OR
  • Graduation Degree with 45% Marks and B.Ed (NCTE Norms) OR
  • Graduation Degree with 50% Marks and BA BED and B.Sc Ed OR
  • Graduation Degree with 50% Marks and B.Ed Special OR 
  • Post Graduation Degree with 55% Marks and 3 Year B.Ed – M.Ed Course. OR
  • Graduation Degree in Any Stream with Diploma in Elementary Education
  • CTET Paper II Qualified
School Teacher (Class 6-8)
  • Graduation / Post Graduation Degree in Related Subject with Minimum 50% Marks & B.Ed Degree OR
  • Graduation / Post Graduation in Related Subject with Minimum 45% Marks (As per 2002 Norms) & B.Ed Degree OR
  • 4 Year Degree in BAEd/ BScEd
  • STET Paper I Exam Qualified
TGT Secondary School Teacher (Class 9-10)
  • Graduation / Post Graduation Degree in Related Subject with Minimum 50% Marks & B.Ed Degree OR
  • Graduation / Post Graduation in Related Subject with Minimum 45% Marks (As per 2002 Norms) & B.Ed Degree OR
  • 4 Year Degree in BAEd/ BScEd
  • STET Paper I Exam Qualified
TGT Secondary School Teacher (Class 9-10 Special)
  • Graduation / Post Graduation Degree in Related Subject with Minimum 50% Marks & B.Ed Degree OR
  • Graduation / Post Graduation in Related Subject with Minimum 45% Marks (As per 2002 Norms) & B.Ed Degree OR
  • 4 Year Degree in BAEd/ BScEd
  • STET Paper I Exam Qualified
PGT Secondary School Teacher (Class 11-12)
  • Master Degree in Related Subject with Minimum 50% Marks & B.Ed Degree OR
  • Master Degree in Related Subject with Minimum 45% Marks (As per 2002 Norms) & B.Ed Degree OR
  • Master Degree in Related Subject with 4 Year Degree in BAEd / BScEd OR
  • Master Degree with 55% Marks & B.Ed – M.Ed 3 Year Degree.
  • STET Paper II Exam Qualified.
